authorityRule: Current audit finding truth is owned by product-audit-finding-register.json and product-audit-section-coverage.json plus current machine/work-slice/executable evidence. This file records how third-pass gaps were discovered and reconciled.

newlyExplicitAuditRequirements.title: Observed liquidity/tradeability must be separated from modeled slippage
newlyExplicitAuditRequirements.requiredOutcome: Treat spread, dollar volume, opening liquidity and other directly observed market inputs as observations. Any slippage estimate is a separate modeled output with model/policy version, inputs, as-of/freshness, uncertainty/coverage and explicit labeling. Never present an estimate as an observed market fact or use an unknown estimate as zero.

newlyExplicitAuditRequirements.title: Alternative/community evidence needs manipulation and provenance controls
newlyExplicitAuditRequirements.requiredOutcome: Community/sentiment/social evidence remains supplemental and untrusted. Preserve source/provenance, rights, timestamp, entity/event linkage, coverage and confidence; detect or down-weight likely manipulation/coordinated amplification/bot/spam/duplicate evidence where feasible; isolate untrusted text from canonical facts and LLM instructions; never let community evidence become an authoritative market fact or bypass deterministic quality/rights gates.

newlyExplicitAuditRequirements.title: Historical analogs/similarity can create false certainty or look-ahead
newlyExplicitAuditRequirements.auditSource: Section 5 Research Decision Brief + Appendix E pattern learning
newlyExplicitAuditRequirements.requiredOutcome: Research historical analogs and future similarity features must use point-in-time, split-safe feature vectors and eligible historical universes including delisted names where required. Show cohort/sample count, uncertainty and regime/liquidity constraints; compare with simple baselines; never present a nearest historical analog as a deterministic forecast. The frozen Decision Brief records the exact snapshot/model/policy/as-of used for the analog context.

alreadyConservedAndReverified: Renderer end-of-file override/duplicate definitions are migration debt and must be modularized with characterization tests.
Legacy OpenAI configuration fields are compatibility-only and retire only after model-independent gateway migration and compatibility evidence.
No-orphan policy evidence is not a complete reachability proof; deletion still requires reachability/usage/rights/replacement evidence.
Exact-head Qualified remains a required checkpoint at G10/material risk boundaries; Fast alone is not full release qualification.
Default-branch required-check enforcement is proven by active ruleset 21244583; CODEOWNER/approval policy and protected release tags remain separate open controls.
CI delivery-health baseline includes lead time, cancellation/amplification, lane duration, flake rate and cost; governance-gate counts are not behavioral coverage.

Research Decision Brief remains immutable-as-of and includes What Changed, Why It Matters, Bull/Base/Bear evidence, contradictions, data quality, catalyst clock, levels, historical analog context, risks and policy/model lineage.
Data Engine/operator machinery remains role/capability-gated and hidden from ordinary users.
Market Activity remains an observation/seed feed rather than an independent qualification engine.
Current audit classification rules remain CURRENT/GAP/TARGET/UNVERIFIED with executable source evidence outranking prose.
